name: Jak
source:
Jak preserves the memories children have of Halloween. His duty is to make sure these memories stay joyful and positive, so that adults recall their childhood Halloweens fondly. 

He's impatient and can be a little mean and irritable, but he's got a heart of gold. 

[Edited from [url=https://hamiltonhour.itch.io/halloween-scrooge]Itch.io[/url]]
